summary: Implemented the SHACL path parser. Added rdflib/extras/shacl.py with parse_shacl_path(shapes_graph, path_identifier) and SHACLPathError, and test/test_extras/test_shacl.py with parametrized valid/invalid cases, a non-node test, and a graph-unchanged test. Ran test/test_extras/test_shacl.py and test/test_path.py with the shared venv Python: 41 passed. mypy, black and isort are not installed in that venv, so type-ignore placement and formatting were checked by reading only. Nothing committed.
